notes.title: Mac and Linux versions released
notes.content:
I release now the Mac and Linux version of Pixel Shooter game.

Pixel Shooter is now available on Mac OS and Linux.

I test it on Mac and it works, but I don't have the opportunity to test it in Linux, if you play the game on Linux and find any bug, please send me a message.
